summary: Mars Outpost is an interactive STEM learning game for children aged 7–12. Players manage a space habitat on Mars by maintaining oxygen, power, food production, and radiation protection while learning real-world space science and engineering
details:
Project: Mars Outpost

Description: An educational game about surviving on Mars.

Problem: Space science is difficult for children to understand.

Solution: Interactive Mars habitat management game.

Features: Oxygen, food, power and radiation management.

Target Audience: Children aged 7–12.

Goal: Make space science fun and interactive.
